objective.text: Get the main switchgear back online

obstacle.text: The switchgear room is deep in the dark. As the power comes back, the dark surges up into the garage.

subobjectives.text: Get down to the switchgear room

objective.text: Open the lock-up and get the torches out

destination.text: Get to the Tower B lobby, where residents are gathering

obstacle.text: Something that used to be people is standing in the concourse.

subobjectives.text: Find the lock-up key in the security office

objective.text: Find out what the dark wants

obstacle.text: The dark has filled the fifth floor of Tower B. Your phone light isn't enough.

subobjectives.text: Get down past the fifth floor
Read the carvings in the foundations

objective.text: Get Leo out of the building

obstacle.text: The dark has taken Tower C's seventh floor.

subobjectives.text: Take Walter's stone from the cabinet
Cross to Tower B on the eighth-floor skybridge

objective.text: Get the dock's generator running so the garage lights come on

obstacle.text: The roller door slams down and won't budge. The only way out is back through the mall.

subobjectives.text: Fuel and start the emergency generator

objective.text: Find your mum in the mall and bring her home

destination.text: Back to the flat on floor 3

obstacle.text: The dark has filled the stairwell on floor 2.

subobjectives.text: Start the building's old backup generator

triggers.text: The lights slam on overhead, and the dark surges up the stairs into the garage.
Far above, the fourth-floor skybridge goes black. The dark knows you understand it now.
Every light in the complex flares at once. Far below, the dark surges up into the garage.
The lock-up swings open: torches, keys, and Walter's old site plans.

As the stone leaves the cabinet, the building shudders. Something settles over Tower C's roof.

What the dark wants is understood

endings.name: Relight
endings.text: The crown beacon blazes over Harrow Court. Floor by floor, the towers light, and the dark draws back into the ground.

endings.name: Seal
endings.text: The floodlights drive it down the stairs, and the blast door booms shut over it. Below, something waits.

endings.name: Return
endings.text: The stone settles into the hollow. The dark goes still, then quiet, then gone. What it wanted was only to be left alone.
